On 26 January 2014, Google confirmed its acquisition of DeepMind for a price reportedly ranging between $400 million and $650 million.
DeepMind Technologies Limited, trading as Google DeepMind or simply DeepMind, is a British-American artificial intelligence (AI) research laboratory which is a subsidiary of Alphabet Inc.

funFact: DeepMind's founder Demis Hassabis said the company began its AI work by teaching software to play 1970s and 80s Atari games like Breakout, Pong and Space Invaders.
